==Original Dream Journal Entry That Inspired The Episode==
I induced lucidity via sleep paralysis. Glow Girl's parents came to bring her home to their universe. (This dream takes place in the same continuity of lucid dreams that started on 06/11/2025 and has continued to the present. These dreams take place in the Elven Village that resembles huts of wood and white stone, as well as castles, and is located in a forest of tall pine trees.) (Glow Girl is a young woman in her twenties with a purple bob haircut with red highlights. She wears a plastic looking crop-top and matching shorts that both contain a sparkling glowing purple liquid, giving both a lava lamp like aesthetic. She also wears black lace-up boots with red laces.) (Glow Girl's parents are Glow Man and Dream Woman.) (Glow Man is a man in his forties with spiky brown hair with glowing green eyes. He wears a black vest, a long sleeve glowing green shirt, black gloves, and black boots with glowing green laces.) (Dream Woman is a woman in her forties with long brown hair, glowing pink eyes, wearing a long sleeve glowing pink shirt, a glowing pink skirt, and matching glowing pink boots.)
But they were followed through a rift by the dragon minions of their nemesis. (The Dragon Minions resemble orange winged snakelike beings with yellow feathery vocal sacs that crawl across the ground with sharp black claws.)
Using the Porta spell, I closed the rift behind them as the heroes returned home. (Closing the rift cut off the minions' psychic connection to their master, effectively making them harmless.)
